pages.title: ACCUM-FILE Operations Runbook
pages.description: Operational procedures for ACCUM-FILE VSAM maintenance, annual reset, and recovery from corruption.
pages.content_summary: Last updated 3 years ago. Contains annual reset procedures and basic corruption recovery steps. Missing: family vs individual accumulator layout, CICS/batch concurrency procedures, packed decimal field definitions.

pages.title: ADJUD-MAIN Batch Operations Guide
pages.description: Batch operations guide for ADJUD-MAIN job stream including restart procedures and common ABEND resolution.
pages.content_summary: 18 months old. Contains basic restart procedures and ABEND codes. Missing: MROUTNG0 routing logic documentation, coverage determination rules, pend queue SLA procedures.

pages.title: Provider Validation Architecture
pages.description: Architecture documentation for provider validation at claim intake including PROV-MSTR VSAM design.
pages.content_summary: 6 months old. Covers PROV-MSTR VSAM structure and validation sequence. Needs update with Wave 2 Provider Data Service architecture and OIG monthly refresh automation.

pages.title: MA Encounter Data Submission — EDPS Guide
pages.description: New page — CMS EDPS encounter data submission guide for MA program. Covers MAENCDR0 program tree, HCC validation, RAF calculation, and submission schedule.
pages.content_summary: Brand new page created this week. Comprehensive guide to MA encounter processing. Current and accurate.

pages.title: COB Engine — Payer Agreement Configuration Guide
pages.description: Guide to configuring COB payer agreements in PAYER_COB_AGREE DB2 table and MCOBPYR0 hardcoded fallthrough logic.
pages.content_summary: Over 2 years old. Partially documents payer agreement configuration. Does not cover the 40 hardcoded payers in COBOL EVALUATE. Incident INC0042512 shows this gap caused a $47K overpayment.

pages.title: OIG Exclusion List — Monthly Refresh Procedure
pages.description: Monthly procedure for refreshing OIG LEIE exclusion data in MiCPS. Covers MPRVEXC0 table update and validation steps.
pages.content_summary: Current. Updated monthly. Covers OIG LEIE refresh, SAM check, and state exclusion list updates.
